segments.quote: I found my mom dead, and I was traumatized too. Therapy really helped me with the trauma. I kept reliving the scene every time I opened any door, and now I'm able to live my grief free from the flashbacks, which is still painful, but at least it's more peaceful.

segments.quote: I have at least 3 NDEs at different times and agree it was so peaceful. I was out of my lifelong pain. And more like taking orders from God on my next mission. He gave a me a choice on whether I wanted to keep going. Like i could ever chose anything different. Of course I’m gonna go back and finish the job.

segments.quote: I no longer fear death. I felt fully connected and whole. And I knew things that I always knew but often don’t have access to. I remember all of it. I now walk around with three heart leaks from the experiences. I’m 46. I consider the extreme heart workouts like exercise that purged whatever needed to be purged from me.

segments.quote: My mom who died at 48 calls out to me at times and gives me encouragement. My grandma, an actual hard core 50’s super house wife executive Polish Baba Yaga, often gripes at me in her loving way - “I didn’t work this hard for you to sit in your ass and not compete this”, etc.
